title: If You Would Be So Kind: Polite Requests
goal: Make polite requests and suggestions with si fuera tan amable de, le agradecería que and sería mejor que.
grammar: Polite requests with si and the imperfect subjunctive

items: I can make a polite request with si fuera tan amable de and le agradecería que.
I can soften a suggestion with sería mejor que and the imperfect subjunctive.
I can use the new words for protocol and courtesy.
